reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Green Dog Dental today and so did my CAT! Yes they treat cats too! I found them on Groupon. It is a very clean and spacious and comfortable atmosphere. My Groupon was for a full blood panel and it was a very good deal. I particularly liked that they did not try to upsell me. I will definitely come back because I liked the staff a lot and this vet is closer to my house in Santa Monica than the Cat Hospital in Marina Del Rey where I was taking him before. The only thing is that 1 am glad I arrived 10 minutes early because street parking was a little challenging.

Everyone at Green Dog is so respectful nice and informative with everything they do. My dog was having an urgent matter and they were able to schedule me for an appointment with the doctor in 30 minutes, which is impeccable. Then when I went in, I was seen promptly. My account was set up quickly, and the doctor was able to give me a thorough yet understanding breakdown of what was going on with my dog. I will definitely be making Green Dog my primary care for my dog care and appreciate their continued help.

This is hands down the best Vet in LA! Very knowledgable staff, fair pricing and great care! They have their own waiting rooms for each client and their pet, very nice and empathic staff. Dr. Geist, the internist, is absolutely amazing and extremely knowledgable. I'd give more stars if I could.
Thank you! Love to bring Enso there for his needs!we feel Supported and we get great care!

Everyone is friendly and sweet with our pups. All the vets we have met with have been terrific. My only complaint is that the package we bought includes many things and it would be nice if, when we booked our dental cleanings, they would suggest, "would you like to get your dog's nails trimmed?" There are several benefits we have not used yet in our package. I realize that it is on us to utilize them but it would be more transparent and frankly, engender more goodwill, if it would offered to and suggested during our bookings of appointments.

I came in with a Groupon for a dental cleaning which I stated many times during my experience. So I was already waiting for a surprise cost.
My dog needed sedation which I was told and actually expected many times. What I was never told ever is that it would cost 125 extra outside of the Groupon. The many times that I was warned that he would need the sedation is when anyone should have mentioned that to me. The manager said that I had signed a release but I signed for a couple costs that did not apply because I had a Groupon. He also said that no medication would be included with the Groupon and that was in the terms. Then he said that antibiotics would be included.  So I was all together confused and could have benefited from transparency. I trusted that if there were any costs beyond the Groupon, I would have been made aware .
Instead it was a surprise cost at the end. At that point I had no more choice. I had to pay bc they were literally holding my dog hostage. Nothing was offered to accommodate me. And besides this I was there wayyy to long. My appointment was at 11… my consultation with the doctor was 1:15 and he was late so after everything, including having to pay the ransom of 125, we were not on our way home until just after 2pm.

The facility was very clean and the staff generally respectful until they are holding your dog hostage so that you can not leave when u want. They said it was for my dog to recover but at 1 pm, it had been more than 30 minutes of recovery.then I had to wait 25+ minutes for the doctor to talk to me. This was in a work day.

Very sketch.

I travel all the way from Gardnerville Nevada to get my dog's teeth cleaned here! They give you an option for a sedation cleaning without using general anesthesia, and they can do everything from xrays to cleaning under the gums. The drs and staff are great.

Had an advanced dental procedure done at Green Dog Dental this week and couldn't be happier. The team clearly knew what they were doing and made sure everything went smoothly. They were also really considerate when it came to pricing, which made a stressful situation a lot easier to manage. Highly recommend if you're looking for a dental team that's both skilled and genuinely looks out for their patients.
Very attentive and understanding staff. Lovely waiting area. I appreciate the comfy consultation rooms. I'm pleasantly surprised (and relieved) how seamless my pet's dental went!
I was very pleased with professionalism of the staff and how we were treated from beginning to end, when I took my dog in for dental cleaning. Also, my dog's teeth look great!
My dog stresses for new events and the staff made him feel comfortable and at ease. They took time to prescribe medication as well prior to visit which helped tremendously.

Dr. Michael Geist and the entire staff at Green Dog Dental are incredible. My dog had seen 2 other vets (Not Green Dog) and she was misdiagnosed. She went through a lot of unnecessary pain. Dr. Geist was thorough and accurate and doing this with humor to lighten the tense situation. I cannot recommend GDD enough. thank you!

What most people do not know is this is a full service Vet center. We "discovered" it when our dog had a dental emergency. The front text was so accommodating in getting him in and seen by a vet. He ended up needing an extraction. The dog, not the vet lol. It went so well and Murphy had an excellent recovery! What I loved was that in the past, at other vets (those that shall not be named;), if you requested a cleaning when your dog was under anesthesia, you would be told it would need to be a separate procedure at another time, with a blood workup and even a full check-up beforehand. Here it was included with his procedure. We were stunned! Anesthesia has risks, and more expense per body weight, so It comes with a pretty steep price tag. Especially if you have a big dog. The entire cost of the procedure with a cleaning, was substantially more affordable than the price of just a cleaning at other vets! This, my friend, is the benefit of having a vet with an in-house dental practice! They also have, I do believe, cardio care available.  Don't be fooled by the name they do treat cats! My son has a kitty with a heart condition so I just let him now he can be treated here as well. If you want to check it out there is a cleaning vouchers you can purchase on Group-on. A very low cost way to check out the vibe of the place and see if it is a good fit for your pet.

An updated review on our happiness with Green Dog: Everyone at Green Dog is friendly, warm, and genuine. The care we get is thorough, and I love the way the process is set up, with the consultation and follow-up in a separate room. Every doctor I've had has been delightful.

Green Dog is such a welcoming and comfortable place. It almost doesn't feel like you're at the vet's office. Front desk representative was warm and kind, and our tech, Crystal, was incredible. She went above and beyond to put me at ease and gave me the confidence I needed to feel that I could give my doggie the shots--which I was very trepidatious about. Both Hampton and I felt like we were in the best hands, of people who truly care. Excellent experience. We thank you!

Very clean office and welcoming people in this place. My dog knows when she's about to be seen by a vet because other vets make their office look and smell like an actual doctor's office! Not here, this office looked and felt like a cool and welcoming boutique! The doctor was amazing and treated my fur baby with love and kindness! Thank you

I am satisfied with the work done for my dog and cat at the facility. I have not had any issues with the receptionist, doctors or their work. Parking is an issue.  But I have been lucky to find parking each time I visit.
Setting the bar for wholistic and progressive approach to veterinary experiences. I couldn’t recommend them enough.

We had a wonderful experience at Green Dog Dental! From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and made both us and our dog feel completely at ease.

The entire team was professional, caring, and took the time to answer all of our questions without making us feel rushed. It’s clear they genuinely care about the animals they treat, and that level of compassion really stood out.

The clinic was clean, well-organized, and the whole visit was smooth from start to finish. We left feeling confident that our pup received excellent care.

I didn’t get a chance to take a photo while we were inside because everyone was so attentive, but I did manage to snap one on the way there! 😊

We highly recommend Green Dog Dental to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, compassionate veterinary dental team. Thank you for such a positive experience—we’ll definitely be back!

Bless these sweet angels who took amazing care of my baby!!!

10/10. I was referred by two friends when I was looking for a non-anesthetic teeth cleaning option for my 6 yo old. They noticed a loose tooth - he had two teeth removed on a later visit. The entire team exceeded expectations. Highly communicative, beautiful facility, top notch care, fair prices.

Dr. Lau and Dr. Scott are absolutely wonderful. They both saw my senior cat during multiple vet visits before she eventually succumbed to her cancer. Before she passed away, they were both compassionate and caring, informative and helpful during one of the most difficult times of my life. I had my sweet girl for half of my life. Dr Lau was honest about the situation but gentle and kind.
Professional, kind, thorough, easy and efficient.

I was very impressed and the vet, Dr V, was very warm, friendly and informative re: my dog's teeth. They were brown when I arrived and white when I left. Very pleased with the results. She did have to undergo IV sedation d/t her being her normally wild self but I was not surprised—I kind of expected it. We were given a full dental report from the vet who did the cleaning—not a tech!! That was a big plus. I did have a Groupon but I would certainly use Green Dog again for Coco's next cleaning without one (first visit only). Coco however does NOT like the sign outside. It set her off growling and barking. We found that entertaining!!
We love green dog Venice. Everyone treats our dogs Ahsoka and Karma with so much love and care.
Thank you for the 5 stars. We appreciate your support!

I took my cat to get exam, and extractions and cleaning under general anesthesia one week ago. Dr. Claudia Lau was professional and kind. I am a dentist for humans, and although I can’t claim to know about veterinary dentistry, I can tell that my cat’s gums look much healthier and less inflamed after his cleaning (as it would in a human) and the stitches she placed around the extraction look very well done. While getting this done was pricey, it is totally reasonable considering the quality of work and time spent by the doctor communicating with me after the procedure. Dr Alexei (who my cat saw for the initial oral exam) and the staff were also excellent with communication as well. Thank you and I look forward to getting my cat’s teeth cleaned in the future.
Thank you for the 5 stars. We appreciate your support!

We have been repeat customers and, until now, have consistently had positive experiences. Unfortunately, today’s incident has completely changed our view.

Due to internal communication failures on their end, our wonderful pup Zoey was unnecessarily kept for the entire day.

A dental exam had already been completed a few days prior, and we had agreed to extract four teeth. We brought our pup in at 9:00 a.m. specifically for that procedure. However, at nearly 1:00 p.m., we received a call asking for approval to extract the same four teeth, which had already been discussed and authorized. This indicates a clear breakdown in internal coordination.

Equally concerning was the lack of accountability. There was no meaningful apology or acknowledgment of responsibility for the error.

Additionally, despite arriving at the time we were instructed for pickup, it took over 30 minutes for our pup to be released. This is particularly frustrating given that customers are charged for late pickups, yet no similar consideration is extended when delays occur on their end.

As pet owners, trust and communication are essential. This experience fell short on both, and as a result, we will not be returning.

If the business would like to make this right, they can contact us directly to offer a proper apology and explanation.

I’ve brought my dog here since 2021. The last two visits I received terrible customer service and I no longer trust Green Dog to provide my dog care. They have no respect for their customers time - plan to wait a long time for drop off and pick up and to receive conflicting information from each person you talk to. No apologies. As a repeat customer, I’m disappointed by this dramatic change in service.

I do not recommend this vet and especially DO NOT USE GROUPON FOR THEM! As others have stated they will hold your pet hostage over an $85 fee. I scheduled what should have been a "fear free" dental cleaning for my pet. The paperwork they handed me upon check-in was already concerning... it was very clear that they cared more about explaining how many ways they planned to charge me instead of the medical history and care of my pet. When they took him back I was initially confused, I've accompanied all of my pets through every exam. The very rare occasions I haven't, have been for medical procedures that required sanitary conditions. Expecting them to know what they were doing, and because at the time they had rave reviews, I agreed to the way it was handled. I was told that if a cleaning could not be performed they would at least perform an exam, which was every bit as important for me because I was worried he was having a tooth issue.

In less than 15 min they came back out and informed me that my pet would not allow them to handle him and the only way they could do a cleaning would be with sedation. I had specifically gone to this place because I wanted to avoid that, so I declined. I was then told that they would not release him until I paid $85 and AFTER that I would receive a refund from Groupon. There didn't seem to be a way around this and I wanted my pet back. I paid the fee and it took forever for them to bring my pet back.

The vet came out to talk with us while we waited. She was very nice but provided very little information on the health of my pet or his teeth, and instead asked me questions about my previous pet who had passed a few months prior.

When they finally returned my pet he looked up at me calmly and confused. He's a pretty chill animal so their assessment still confuses me... but I initially chalked it up to me not being in the room and him being confused by that.

Now I think this place is a scam. I can't figure out if they take your pet in the back and just do nothing, or if at the slightest resistance from the animal they claim your pet needs medication so that they can attempt to up charge you at every corner. In any case, I would not trust them with your pet, something really weird is going on here. I took my pet to another vet a couple weeks later (where I was able to sit in the room with him) for a dental exam and he was perfectly calm and allowed the vet to do everything they needed to him. Honestly I was just glad I got him back given how odd this place runs.

To add to the stress, when I tried to get refunded from Groupon because they were unable to perform the service, they refused me! I contacted Green Dog and they told me they contacted Groupon to issue the refund on my behalf. Groupon still refused! I tried to contact Green Dog again to get it fixed and no one would reply to me anymore. I ended up having to do a charge back on my credit card which was a giant hassle and they tried to fight me on it!

For multiple reasons, I do not recommend this vet!
Wonderful clinic!they are very nice with customers and their services with pets is awesome!

After a stressful experience elsewhere, I’m incredibly grateful I found Green Dog Dental. I took my dog in for a dental cleaning at another clinic, where they discovered a foreign body and removed it. They recommended extracting a tooth due to a small hole in his gums, but no X-rays were taken. I didn’t feel comfortable agreeing to an extraction without imaging or a clear explanation of why removing the tooth would help the hole heal. When I asked about suturing the gum instead, I was told I needed to seek a dental specialist. From the start, communication was smooth. I was able to explain my dog’s situation over the phone and get scheduled within a week. I made it very clear that my dog is reactive when strangers touch his mouth. Although I can handle his mouth and have shown his teeth during vet exams, he was attacked a few years ago and needed facial sutures, so he understandably has boundaries. I explained that he would  need sedation for a proper dental evaluation.
The only hiccup in the process was that after waiting about 1.5 hours, I was told I needed to muzzle him. Since I had mentioned his reactivity and need for sedation ahead of time, I felt this could have been communicated earlier, as it delayed his appointment. That said, Dr. Scott was amazing. She was thorough, patient, and took the time to explain everything while truly listening to my concerns. They performed dental X-rays which showed bone loss in one molar. As much as I hated the idea of extraction, I felt confident in the decision because they showed me exactly which tooth needed removal, especially after another clinic had recommended extracting a different molar without X-rays.
The front desk staff was kind and patient throughout the process. I had even called other “dental specialists” and obtained quotes (and tentatively scheduled elsewhere in case a root canal was needed), but everything was handled here. Pricing was clear, transparent, and far more reasonable than other places I contacted. Overall I felt heard, respected, and confident in my dog’s care. I would absolutely recommend Green Dog Dental to anyone needing specialized dental care for their pet.
Love the experience. My pet is well taken care of always.

I was able to book an appointment easily; however, confirming my appointment was extremely frustrating. I never received a confirmation email and attempted multiple times to call to confirm the appointment time. I called the day of and was placed on hold for 47 minutes with a recording stating that call volume was too high, to wait, yet no one ever answered.

I arrived approximately eight minutes after my scheduled appointment and was politely informed that I was late, though they did allow me to check in. I explained that I had been trying to call to confirm my appointment time and had been placed on hold for an extended period. The woman at the front desk apologized, but a male staff member was largely indifferent.

The veterinarian himself was patient, polite, and took time to thoroughly explain the procedure, which I appreciated. Unfortunately, the experience with the rest of the staff was very different.

When my dog was brought out, I was told they did not have his leash, even though I had handed my dog over with it. A staff member responded defensively when I insisted the leash was there. I was told to call back if I did not find it in my car, but once again could not reach anyone by phone. I returned inside and asked that they check their security cameras. Only then did they locate the leash and return it to me, without any apology.

Throughout the visit, several staff members came across as short, disengaged, and at times entitled, as though they were doing me a favor rather than providing a service.

Due to the lack of communication, accountability, and overall professionalism, I did not feel comfortable leaving my dog in their care and canceled the upcoming appointments and procedure.

While the veterinarian was kind and professional, I would not recommend this facility based on my experience with the staff.
great place . nice area to wait as well. the doctor did a great job explaining the post dental work too which I appreciated

My French Bulldog had his dental cleaning and tooth extractions this week and the procedure went great!  With a brachycephalic breed, you can imagine I was anxious. Hearing my dog needed 10 teeth pulled was hard to hear, but both doctors went over in depth why the teeth needed to go via the X-rays. Showing visuals and explaining everything simply made it easier for me to authorize the removal.

The office staff was incredibly kind. Thank you Aislinn, Dr. Alzate, & Dr. Scott. They all put my mind at ease and took great care of Archie.

Bonus: I was able to pick up Archie early post surgery & pay with Scratchpay! Interest free for 6 months.

Dr Geist and the entire staff at the Venice office always make us so welcome. Indeed, they are like family at this point. We've been going there for three years now since Sparky came to live with us after our friends and his former humans moved from San Francisco to London with two small children.  Sparky is so accustomed to the staff and beautiful venue at the Venice office that he doesn't even show any apprehension at entering. It also helps that you guys don't try and pitch us a hard sell on treatment he doesn't need. We just hope Dr Geist doesn't leave because then we'd have to follow him wherever he goes next.  The front office staff is also beyond compare.  Green Dog Dental Venice is the best vet anywhere.

I appreciate that I was able to get an appointment within a day's notice. The front desk was great and Dr. Scott did a wonderful job of explaining my dog's dental procedure/needs. She also didn't rush me. She let me ask my questions.
The Staff at Green Dog Dental put in the effort and took years off of my dog’s teeth, she smells and looks like a fresh puppy now. I’m very happy with the service and results. Would recommend.

Hi Louise,
Thank you so much for the 5 stars! We truly appreciate your support.

I took our dog Blu in for a follow up visit. The staff at Green Dog was very professional and kind. They immediately examined Blu and made me feel very good of my decision to trust Green Dog with Blu''s care. I will highly recommend Green Dog.
Staff is always so kind and knowledgeable. Location is spotless. My dog is always comfortable when I bring him.

My dog has been a loyal patient at Green Dog for six years. Today, he went in for what was supposed to be a simple, routine cleaning — and it turned into one of the most frightening experiences I’ve ever had as a pet owner.

While I was out running errands, I received a text informing me they planned to use anesthesia. I immediately responded telling them not to proceed and rushed back to the clinic. When I arrived, I expected to be able to take him home right away, but instead I waited anxiously for 45 minutes with no explanation.

Even more upsetting, I had previously given clear instructions to pause all cleanings and physical exams — yet they still attempted to charge me $85 for services that should never have been performed in the first place. Throughout all of this, no one would update me on my dog’s status or even tell me where he was.

I was left stressed, confused, and terrified for my dog’s wellbeing — and completely disappointed by the lack of communication, disregard for my instructions, and the attempt to bill me despite doing exactly what I asked them not to do.
Such wonderful service. From the greeting upon entry, timeliness of being helped, good communication, and quick and easy check out. The vets are knowledgeable and kind. I trust my dog in their care.

Update Review 11/24/2025

I’ve been bringing my dog here for dental cleanings, and this was our fourth visit. I arrived at 10:40 AM and was told my dog was a good candidate for a non-sedated cleaning. Around 11:50 AM, I was finally called into the room to speak with the vet.

He started by saying my dog’s teeth were fine. Then, out of nowhere, he began talking about how my dog is “too anxious” and should take medication before the next visit. I asked him directly, “Why are you talking about medication? Did something happen?” Only then did he finally explain what actually happened.

During the pre-checkup, my dog became anxious while being weighed, so they put a muzzle on him. He tried to nudge it off, his dewclaw got caught, and it came off. I only learned this after asking multiple times. They never informed me when it happened, and they continued with the entire dental cleaning while he was injured and in pain.

What upset me the most:

The vet did not apologize about what happened before recommending medication.

He made it sound like my dog’s behavior caused the injury, instead of acknowledging how their handling contributed.

He acted as if this was normal and not a big deal.

They never told me this was an “anxiety issue” in the previous three cleanings we’ve done at the same clinic.

If something happens before a procedure, an owner should be notified immediately—not after everything is already done.

The only reason this is a 2-star review and not 1-star is because the store manager followed up later. I appreciate the effort and the check-in.

But I will not be returning. This experience showed me they don’t care about the dog owner’s trust or the dog’s emotional well-being.

Previous Review

We have been to this place twice for my dog's dental cleaning. I couldn't brush my dog's teeth every day, and I started worrying about his dental health. I was hesitant to put him under anesthesia for dental cleaning, but then I found a place that offers non-anesthetic dental cleaning. Although it's not very close to where I live in South Redondo Beach, I decided to give it a try last year for the first time.

It worked really well, so I visited again for the dental cleaning this month. Is it worth driving 50 minutes? YES!!
Great experience from booking the appointment to picking up my pup.
Very thorough and caring with our pup, did exactly what they said they would do and on time.
Greendog Dental and Vet Center has been our vet for years and repeat clients say it all.

Absolutely love this vet! I have gone to both Van Nuys and Venice locations and everyone is super helpful. They also text so if you have any questions, they can help via text (except doctor-required information, of course). A huge shout out to Shelby, Sierra, Brittany, Acelyn, and Crystal--all extremely helpful and sweet staff members. They have been extremely helpful with my cat and my boyfriend's cat and went above and beyond. Also, their prices are more reasonable than other vets and the offices are so nice!! Highly recommend across the board.

Edit after response from owner: I brought my basset hound Freckles here after our previous Vet moved locations. They originally were great and provided a great service, but over time became harder to work with. They made it excessively difficult for us to renew our dogs heartworm medication (three additional visits needed?) and the manager Tiffany was unpleasant and accusatory with both me and my wife over the phone. I noticed many other recent 1 star reviews and am glad I'm taking my little doggy elsewhere :)

My dog needed quite a few teeth removed and within a few days of calling had a really successful surgery at the hands of incredibly thoughtful and knowledgeable doctors and staff. Cher is feeling great and we’re so happy we chose green dog! Everyone is so kind here & mindful of costs/budget and your and your dogs experience — I couldn’t recommend them enough. Thank you guys!
Staffs always attentive and friendly. Appreciate their excellence in customer service and attention to detail from intake to the complete and overall process.
Love Green Vet Dental & Veterinarian! Always professional and friendly! My dog hates the vet, they work with him to make it as painless as possible.

DO NOT GO HERE!!!
My dog would have almost died if I would have listened to them. I had to go to another vet after a standard procedure at Greendog. They don´t care if your pet lives or dies!

My German Shepherd went in for a routine tooth cleaning here and almost didn’t make it out alive. The only reason he is still with us is because I rushed him to another vet.

Management kept promising to “investigate”and call me back, but they just ghosted me again and again. Zero accountability.

They did not take this seriously at all.

If you value your pet’s life, do not bring them here. They only care about the money.

My German shepherd had a normal tooth cleaning procedure here and would have almost died afterwards if I wouldn’t have gone to another vet.
They did not take the situation seriously at all!
If you care about your pet, do NOT go here! They just care about the money!
The place didn't feel like a vet hospital.  A very cool vibe along with outstanding customer service!
We had a wonderful visit. Great staff!
Great experience
Nice atmosphere, amazing service
All went great today! The staff always take such great care of our precious boy. Love this place!

Today had to take my dog in for emergency visit so of course I was stressed. Luckily when I called Green Dog made it easy to get a same day appointment Their staff was helpful and attentive which made my dog feel at ease right away. The vet explained everything clearly during the checkup, and I appreciated the time they took to go over the treatment options. At the end of the visit, my dog seemed comfortable and happy, which was a relief. I’d highly recommend Green Dog for anyone looking for solid, professional care for their pets. I have been going to them for over 10 yrs and never had anything but top notch treatment for my dog from them.
The entire team was very professional, and the facilities are clean. The dental cleaning went well; of note, our dog is 14 y.o. and tolerated the anesthesia and cleaning without any issues.
Very kind and professional staff. My dog isn't the easiest and everyone was positive and helpful. I'm definitely going to return and highly recommend!

Everyone from the front desk to the vet tech to the veterinarian were kind, professional, and efficient. The location was very clean and organized. My two dogs were immediately calmed and reassured in this space.

Hi. I found Green Dog Dental on Groupon and I'm honestly thrilled with the whole situation. I specifically googled to find vets that specialize in dentistry for my dog's 1st anesthetized cleaning and the Groupon for the initial bloodwork and oral exam came right up first. Well, it was a no brainer to buy it and go here. I had no idea that this gem of a place existed, and it was honestly very reasonably priced, which was also great. It is hard to find vets that have additional expertise in dental care, as most just offer overpriced cleanings to keep up with the need.  At Green Dog, everyone I dealt with was so nice and communicative and my dog did great here. Her teeth look so clean and white and her breath is nice too. I'm so lucky that the owner AND 2 other vets consulted with me and treated my dog throughout the process. They were kind, loving and helpful with my baby and showed attentive care towards her. I'm excited to share this place with others.  Thanks Green Dog Team!

One of the best experiences I’ve had at a vet, in 15 years of owning a dog! They were simply amazing, I am absolutely blown away at how well they cleaned my pups teeth, and can’t believe I put off teeth cleaning until now. He finally has fresh breath!!!! They don’t try to upsell anything, were super thorough with explaining everything and were very clear about expected future treatments. I’ve been home 10 minutes and could not wait to write this review!

Hi Sabrina,
Thank you for the 5 star review, we hope to see you again soon!
They are always so kind and take the best care of my dog

Our little 10-year-old dog has super high anxiety but everyone at Green dog dental is so kind and gentle with her that she doesn’t panic when we go for her annual teeth cleaning.

Wish I had known about them years ago. Our other regular vet never told us she had many rotten teeth And we had to find it ourselves several years ago, so by the time we got to Green dog dental, they showed us her inflamed gums and they had to remove several teeth. Yet she doesn’t tremble when she goes there! She really trusts everyone there.
Hidden gem wish I found this place earlier. Grade A staff and service

The care I received here was exceptional. The friendliness, the insane compassion for the animals can be seen in the mood and behavior of every single employee. this is a rare breed of businesses. I will be shouting this from the mountain top.

Shelby was the sweetest informative receptionist I’ve ever talked to. Very professional and was able to answer all my questions. Excited to bring my dog for her non-anesthetic teeth cleaning. I feel very comfortable just with the first phone call!

I can't believe I didn't know about you sooner! Everything is so well thought out, the waiting room was warm and inviting. Henry will typically tremble until we leave, once he was in the waiting room he stopped. The staff was wonderful, the vet was amazing. We will be making Green Dog our primary vet. Please thank your team for such an exceptional experience! Warm regards ~ Jennifer guerrera
We are so happy with Oprah's care at your establishment! Thank you so much for all you do! It's so nice to have a local vet clinic we can trust.

Green Dog dental definitely provides exceptional patient care and customer service. We were greeted with a smile and were seen right away. The vet also was very informative and clear about the needs my pet had and patiently answered all our questions and concerns. So glad I found this place!

From dental care to checkups to bloodwork to tumors and everything in between, we won’t go anywhere else. We travel 45 minutes each way for them. Both locations are wonderful and her vet, Geist, bounces between the two. Her surgeon, Faro, is the best. He got all of my baby’s cancer out and was so good to both of us throughout it – patient, kind, thorough in explaining and answering questions, followed up, and even helped with another issue afterwards. Texting and emailing the front desk is so helpful, too! It never feels like they’re trying to get every dollar they can out of you. 10/10 recommend.

If you're wondering why Green Dog has so many glowing reviews, it's worth noting they seem to manipulate the narrative by offering refunds in exchange for silence. This is exactly what happened to me after the worst experience I've ever had at a pet care establishment and their bribe attempt was disgraceful.

From the moment I walked in until the moment I left, the treatment both my dog and I received was shocking and completely unacceptable. I’m sharing my personal experience so you can make an informed decision and hopefully avoid the distress I went through.

I scheduled a dental exam for my dog to get a second opinion about her teeth. However, when I arrived, they mistakenly prepared to perform a full dental cleaning - something I had explicitly stated I did not want. After clarifying, they took my dog to the back, saying the exam would take 45 minutes to check each tooth thoroughly and provide a report.

That’s when the ordeal truly began.

About 20 minutes in, I heard a dog barking incessantly. Concerned, I asked the receptionist if it was my dog, and they confirmed it was. I was told she was done with the exam and someone would come to speak with me soon. Meanwhile, I waited, listening to my stressed dog continue barking behind closed doors.

Another 15–20 minutes passed, and I still hadn’t seen my dog or spoken to a vet. Worried, I asked if she could sit with me while I waited to calm her nerves. That’s when things escalated. I was told, “You have to pay for the exam first before you can get your dog. That's the compromise.” Yes, they were holding my dog hostage over an $85 fee, even though I hadn’t been shown any results or spoken to a vet.

I explained my concerns: my dog wasn’t just barking for no reason; she's not a barker and she should be able to sit with me instead of being alone.  Instead of showing empathy, they insisted I pay before they’d even let me comfort her. I told them the compromise is if they do not bring my dog out, they will need to comfort her while she is waiting in the back and they agreed.  My dog does not know these people and vice versa,, it was her first visit, and they do not know what is best for her after meeting her 20 minutes prior.  They did not know that she was dealing with severe separation anxiety after I had been away on an eight-month work assignment and recently returned.

Imagine taking your child to a doctor for the first time. You hand them off,  only to be told that you must pay for the exam before they’ll return your child to you. The sheer audacity of such a policy would leave any parent horrified—and yet, that’s exactly what happened to me at Green Dog.

Another 10 minutes later, a vet came out and shared the results of the exam, which, to my disbelief, was only partially completed. They didn’t even check all her teeth as promised, citing the need for a $600 radiograph to proceed further. At this point, I had enough. I paid the $85, retrieved my dog, and left. That was an unnecessary stressful situation for both my dog and myself.

When I called to share my experience with a manager, she expressed shock and said someone would follow up. No one did. When I followed up myself a week later, they offered a refund - but only if I signed an NDA to keep quiet about what happened.
I’m horrified by these practices and felt compelled to share my story so other pet parents can decide whether this is the kind of treatment they’re willing to risk. My only hope is that no one else has to endure what my dog and I went through.

Pets are family, and they deserve to be treated with compassion and respect, not as leverage to extract payment. This experience left me shaken, and I wouldn’t wish it on anyone.

Good luck, and proceed with caution.
